purpose: Teach: 画質/長老/竿/無限/分子/頭文字/劇的/ラグビー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、テレビの、絶対、画質、絶対、悪かったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, you remember — back when we were young, the TV picture quality really was absolutely terrible, wasn't it?
lines.style: Nostalgic, slightly amused by the memory. Gentle opening, warm cadence. Speaks as though seeing it all again. Soft pause before the question mark, inviting her to join the recollection.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、町の、絶対、長老、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、ご相談に行ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh yes. Back then, we'd go visit the village elder — your grandfather — to ask for advice, remember dear? We really did.
lines.style: Warm, affirming. Voice brightens at the memory. Speaks with the ease of someone who's held this memory a long time. Gentle emphasis on 'your grandfather' — a small nod to shared family history.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、釣り、絶対、竿、絶対、自分で、絶対、作ったぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: Your father made his own fishing rod back then, you remember that, Gran? He really did.
lines.style: Quieter wonder in the voice. Eyes seem to be following the memory of hands working wood. Pace slows slightly, almost reverently. The question is genuine — inviting her to confirm something precious.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、無限、絶対、の、絶対、可能性、絶対、夢見ていたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Your grandfather dreamed of limitless possibility back then, remember? He truly did.
lines.style: Softer register, almost dreamlike. Speaks as though she's seeing him clearly across the years. Slight lift at 'limitless possibility' — the wonder in his hope. Tender fade at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、分子、絶対、生物学、絶対、本、絶対、読んだぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: Your father was reading molecular biology books back in those days, do you remember, Gran? He really was.
lines.style: Proud undertone, like a son seeing his father's ambition again. Steady, warm voice. Light emphasis on the seriousness of the reading — intellectual curiosity matters here. Genuine check-in at the question.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、家紋の、絶対、頭文字、絶対、刻んだわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Your grandfather carved the family crest initials back then, remember dear? He really did that.
lines.style: Admiring, almost reverent. Voice carries the weight of craftsmanship and intention. Deliberate pace — each detail matters. Warm affection for the memory of his hands at work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、商売、絶対、劇的、絶対、に、絶対、伸びたぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: Your father's business grew dramatically back then, do you remember, Gran? It truly did flourish.
lines.style: Pride and satisfaction in the voice, but grounded — not boasting, just affirming. Warm and steady. Slight emphasis on 'grew' and 'flourished' as though watching it happen. Gentle confirmation.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、ラグビー、絶対、若い頃、絶対、選手だったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Your grandfather was a rugby player back in those days, remember dear? He really was.
lines.style: Voice lights up at the image — youth and strength. Warm, quick smile in the tone. Gentle affection for the memory of him young and capable. Close, intimate — speaking to someone who knew him then too.
